acceptance_evidence.public_bindings: Actual retained aq-git repo.register/repo.show expected-generation exchange and workspace-scoped graph API1 read through existing configured adapters. No private component state, caller URLs, paths or credential values are accepted. Stale generation update refuses and preserves prior project revision.
acceptance_evidence.revision_and_replay: Owner/CAS mutations, actor-scoped durable operation receipts, immutable revision history, exact retries after group config changes, changed-payload conflicts, and current config validation for new mutations.
acceptance_evidence.authority_and_scope: Viewer and unknown field/group refusals; configured operator group membership, exact node/profile/environment restrictions, revoked/offline node denial; no worker-self-asserted group authority.
acceptance_evidence.freshness_and_fencing: Subject-bound external observations retain actual observation time and source identity. Mutation lock-wait expiry rolls back. Final read-only local fence rechecks node revocation after lock waits in node/project/catalog order. Future AQ08 offer consumers must use the same fence inside their actual offer transaction and retain locks through insertion.
acceptance_evidence.immutability: Frozen project snapshots and historical revisions survive project edits and profile catalog activation unchanged; future eligibility blocks changed project/catalog revisions.
acceptance_evidence.availability: Absent/stale/forbidden/unavailable/unsupported external observations prevent eligibility; disable remains available during external outages. No provider observations are probed by these routes.

limits: Eligibility is project worker policy, never a provider/model selection or execution grant; AQ20/AQ08 must bind the actual assignment, context retention and authority before a profiled offer.
AQ17 central supervisors require distinct central authority and cannot fabricate worker node IDs; ProjectRecord policy/ceilings remain independent reusable facts.
No clone/init/GitHub onboarding, copied graph task lifecycle, per-project worktree slots or private Git registry edits are introduced.
Policy/context references do not imply content retrieval or permissions; consumers still fetch scoped exact revisions and apply all ceilings.
Configured graph credential and aq-git socket are reused behind fixed logical adapter references; this increment adds no editable credential registry.
History and receipts are retained under declared quotas rather than silently pruned; quota exhaustion refuses new policy writes.
review_revisions: Exact put retry is resolved before current worker-group validation while current owner authentication remains mandatory.
External observation expiry is rechecked after transaction lock waits and before commit; observation time is never reset to commit time.
Final local admission seam locks node, project and catalog in canonical order and compares group configuration digest.
Routine project fixture tests serialize to avoid accidentally exercising the deliberately fail-fast process-global external verification pool.
qualification_note: Only the root clean detached source-revision runs and isolated-target logs are retained here. Earlier temporary-copy preflights are not release qualification. Other live CON03/AQ20 files are excluded from this git-show inventory.
